arguments.text: overflow_me: no PIE, no canary, NX. main: read(0,rbp-0x8,8) -> prints *(rbp-0x8) as "post-it ... 0x%lx" (leaks secret_key); read(0,rbp-0x10,8) -> must equal secret_key to call get_input. get_input: reads 8 bytes /dev/urandom into global val, stores copy at rbp-0x10, prints val, then gets(rbp-0x50) — must NOT overwrite rbp-0x10 (canary check) else exit. Buffer overflow: 0x50+8=88 bytes to saved RIP; ret to get_flag (0x401424) which runs system("cat flag.txt").
